text: 全員が白旗 / 戦う意思がないってことでしょうか
translation: Everyone's holding white flags. Does that mean they have no intention to fight?
grammar: ～ってことでしょうか is a casual form of ～ということでしょうか meaning 'does that mean...?'

text: まず最初に聞いていただきたいことがあります
translation: First of all, there's something I'd like you to hear.
grammar: ～ていただきたい is a humble/polite form meaning 'I'd like you to...' (literally 'I'd like to receive the favor of...')

text: 私たちはあなたの敵ではありません / トゥービー機械生命体の言うことなんて信じちゃダメです
translation: We are not your enemy. / 2B, you mustn't believe anything a machine lifeform says.
grammar: ～なんて adds dismissive emphasis (something like..., the likes of...); ～ちゃダメ is casual prohibition

text: 確かにあなたたちにとって私たち機械生命体は敵です
translation: Certainly, to you, we machine lifeforms are enemies.

text: 私の名前はパスカル / この村の王さんをしています
translation: My name is Pascal. I'm the chief of this village.
grammar: ～をしています means 'to be doing (a job/role)'

text: この村に住む者たちは / 戦いから逃げてきた平和主義者しかいません
translation: Those who live in this village are only pacifists who have fled from battle.
grammar: ～しかいません means 'there are only...', 'nothing but...'

text: よければ皆さん自身の目で確認してみてください
translation: If you'd like, please confirm it with your own eyes.

vocabulary.meaning: if it's okay, if you'd like

grammar: ～てみてください means 'please try doing...'

text: その箱を動かせば廃墟都市に出られますね
translation: If we move that box, we can get out to the ruined city, right?
grammar: ～ば is conditional 'if'; ～られる is potential form 'can do'

text: オペレーター210より9S定期連絡を行います
translation: This is Operator 210 conducting a routine contact with 9S.

text: 本日は9Sに重要事項の連絡があります
translation: Today I have an important matter to communicate to 9S.

text: 何でしょう / 整備部から9Sの飛行ユニットの扱いについて苦情が入りました
translation: What is it? / We received a complaint from the maintenance department about your handling of the flight unit.

vocabulary.meaning: to come in, to be received

text: 勝手に改造するのはやめてほしいとのことです / いやだって衛星からの情報に余計なデータがあって射撃補正が遅れるから仕方なく
translation: They want you to stop modifying it without permission. / But the satellite information has unnecessary data that delays the firing correction, so I had no choice...

vocabulary.meaning: it is said that, they say

grammar: だって is casual 'but/because'; ～から indicates reason

text: 反論があるなら自分で整備部に行って話すなり殴りなりして解決してください / 以上
translation: If you have any objections, go to the maintenance department yourself and resolve it by talking or punching them or whatever. / That's all.
grammar: ～なり～なり means 'either...or...', 'whether...or...'; ～てください is a polite command

text: オペレーターさんって意外と乱暴なのかな
translation: I wonder if the Operator is unexpectedly rough.
grammar: ～って is casual topic marker; ～かな expresses wonder or uncertainty

text: 我走了
translation: I'm leaving.
grammar: This is Chinese, not Japanese

text: いかがでしょうか / なあ、勝手に通信してきた
translation: How was it? / Hey, he contacted us without permission.
grammar: ～てきた indicates an action toward the speaker

text: 私たちが平和を愛していることをご理解いただけましたか
translation: Have you understood that we love peace?
grammar: ご～いただけましたか is very polite 'were you able to receive the favor of...?'

text: 口だけならいくらでも言える機会には心がないんだから / そうかもしれません
translation: You can say anything with just words. Machines don't have hearts. / That may be so.

vocabulary.meaning: as much as one wants, anything

grammar: ～だけなら means 'if it's just...'; ～んだから emphasizes reason/justification

text: でもこれからも良ければこの村に来てください
translation: But from now on, if you'd like, please come to this village.

text: ДИНАМИЧНАЯ МУЗЫКА
translation: DYNAMIC MUSIC
grammar: This is Russian, not Japanese

text: 対話することでしかそうご理解は得られない
translation: Such understanding can only be gained through dialogue.
grammar: ～することでしか means 'only by doing...'; ～られない is negative potential

text: 私はそう思っています / そう
translation: That's what I think. / I see.

text: 何の音だろう
translation: I wonder what that sound is.
grammar: ～だろう expresses speculation or wonder

text: バンカーより9Sに緊急連絡 / 廃墟都市地帯に敵大型兵器の出現を確認 / 随伴する機械生命体反応が多数 / 全ヨルハ部隊に出撃命令が下りました
translation: Emergency contact to 9S from the Bunker. Confirmed appearance of enemy large-scale weapon in the ruined city area. Multiple accompanying machine lifeform reactions detected. A sortie order has been issued to all YoRHa units.

text: 大型兵器 / トゥビーやっぱりこいつら
translation: Large-scale weapon... / 2B, I knew it, these guys...

text: 僕らを罠にかけようとして
translation: They're trying to trap us.
grammar: ～ようとして means 'trying to...', 'attempting to...'

text: 私たちもその情報を知りませんでした
translation: We didn't know that information either.

text: 信じていただけないかもしれませんが / 可能であれば信じてほしいです / どっちでもいい倒しに行く
translation: You may not believe us, but if possible, I want you to believe us. / Either way, I'm going to destroy it.

vocabulary.meaning: either way is fine, doesn't matter

grammar: ～ていただけない is negative potential of humble form; ～かもしれません means 'may not'

text: オペレーター21をより連絡 9S
translation: Contact from Operator 210, 9S.
grammar: Likely audio transcription error; should be オペレーター210より

text: 悪いニュースと良いニュースがそれぞれ一つずつ / まず 巨大兵器は2体存再することを確認 / 2体?あんなのか?
translation: One piece of bad news and one piece of good news each. First, confirmed that there are two giant weapons in existence. / Two? Things like that?
grammar: あんなの is casual for 'things like that'

text: 次は良いニュース / 前回の巨大兵器との戦闘データから / 敵兵器装甲を分析 / 弱点と思われる箇所の特定に成功しました
translation: Next is the good news. From the combat data with the giant weapon last time, we analyzed the enemy weapon's armor. We succeeded in identifying locations believed to be weak points.

vocabulary.meaning: to be thought, believed to be

text: また得られたデータを基にした射撃ユニットの改良が完了 / 搭載した飛行ユニットを配置します
translation: Also, improvements to the firing unit based on the obtained data have been completed. We'll deploy flight units equipped with them.
grammar: ～を基にした means 'based on...'

text: さすがはヨルファ開発部
translation: As expected of the YoRHa development department.

vocabulary.meaning: as expected, just as one would expect

grammar: さすがは emphasizes 'as expected of...'

text: マップデータを確認してください / 了解しました
translation: Please check the map data. / Understood.

text: トゥビー、司令部から飛行ユニットの配備の連絡がありました / 座標をポイントしたので、向かいましょう / わかった
translation: 2B, there was contact from command about the deployment of flight units. I've marked the coordinates, so let's head there. / Got it.

text: 大型兵器の足元は危ないですね / どこか別のルートを探した方がいい気がします
translation: The feet of the large weapon are dangerous. I feel we should look for an alternate route somewhere.
grammar: ～た方がいい means 'it would be better to...'; ～気がする means 'I feel that...'

text: 飛行ユニットはこの先のビル屋上に配備されてますね
translation: The flight units are deployed on the rooftop of the building ahead.
grammar: ～てます is casual contraction of ～ています

text: 危険ですが、あの大型兵器の足元を通らないと
translation: It's dangerous, but we have to pass under that large weapon's feet.
grammar: ～ないと (truncated from ～ないといけない) means 'must do', 'have to do'

text: たどり着けそうにありません / 気をつけていきましょう
translation: We won't be able to reach it. / Let's go carefully.
grammar: ～そうにない means 'doesn't seem like it will...', 'unlikely to...'

text: ДИНАМИЧНАЯ МУЗЫКА
translation: DYNAMIC MUSIC
grammar: This is Russian, not Japanese

text: 2Bの配線が集中しているハブの情報を表示します
translation: Displaying information on hubs where 2B's wiring is concentrated.

text: 今のうちに飛行ユニットの場所まで移動しましょう
translation: Let's move to the location of the flight units while we can.

vocabulary.meaning: while we can, now (while there's a chance)

text: 上空は敵の対空兵器で危険です / 低空飛行での接近を推奨します / 了解しました
translation: The sky is dangerous with enemy anti-aircraft weapons. We recommend approaching via low-altitude flight. / Understood.

text: ДИНАМИЧНАЯ МУЗЫКА
translation: DYNAMIC MUSIC
grammar: This is Russian, not Japanese

text: 敵大型兵器 全機機能停止を確認
translation: Confirmed that all enemy large-scale weapons have stopped functioning.

text: 敵兵器が再充電してます
translation: The enemy weapon is recharging.

text: 敵兵器の振動さらに増加中 / 戦闘地域の地下空間が共鳴しています
translation: Enemy weapon vibrations increasing further. The underground space in the combat area is resonating.

text: これは…
translation: This is...

text: まさか… / 数百年も姿を現さなかったエイリアンが 地下にいるだと
translation: It can't be... The aliens who haven't shown themselves for hundreds of years are underground?
grammar: ～だと expresses surprise or disbelief

text: 司令部より全ヨルハ部隊へ / 数百年もの間発見されなかったエイリアンたちの反応を確認した / 知っていると思うが、エイリアンは機械生命体たちの司令塔だ。
translation: From command to all YoRHa units. We have confirmed reactions from the aliens who went undiscovered for hundreds of years. As you know, the aliens are the command tower of the machine lifeforms.

vocabulary.meaning: during the time, for the period

grammar: ～と思うが means 'I think/you probably know, but...'

text: エイリアンを殲滅すれば、長きに渡るこの戦争も終結する。 / 現在、技術部の方で電波波心源の解析を進めているが、情報が不足している。
translation: If we annihilate the aliens, this long war will also end. Currently, the technical department is proceeding with analysis of the radio wave source, but information is insufficient.
grammar: ～ば means 'if'; ～ているが means 'is doing, but...'

text: 地上にいるヨルハ部隊は、本案件に対する情報収集を最優先しろ。 / この後期を逃してはならない。
translation: YoRHa units on the ground, make information gathering on this matter your top priority. We must not miss this opportunity.

vocabulary.reading: じょうほうしゅうしゅう

grammar: ～てはならない is strong prohibition meaning 'must not'

text: 人類に栄光あれ。 / 司令部の情報をもとに、信号波心源を予測。
translation: Glory to mankind. Based on command's information, predicting the signal wave source.

text: マップにマークしました / でもこれ地下の深めの場所みたいですけど / 行ってみればわかるよ
translation: I've marked it on the map. But this looks like a pretty deep underground location... / You'll know when we go there.
grammar: ～てみれば means 'if you try doing...'; わかる means 'you'll understand/know'

text: 多分 / 2Bって大雑把なところがあるんですね
translation: Probably. / So 2B has a rough side to her.
grammar: ～んですね is explanatory tone with agreement/realization

text: 2B反応があった陥没地帯の地下に行ってみましょう
translation: 2B, let's try going underground in the sunken area where there was a reaction.

text: これは / 地下にある空間の崩落による陥没
translation: This is... subsidence caused by the collapse of an underground space.

text: こんな巨大な空洞がどうして
translation: Why is there such a giant cavity...

text: なんだあの変な敵は
translation: What are those weird enemies?

text: ここの通路は昔からあるみたいですけど
translation: It looks like this passageway has been here since long ago.

text: 機械生命体たちの残骸が / でもこれずいぶん昔からここにあるような感じですね
translation: Machine lifeform wreckage... But it feels like this has been here for quite a while.
grammar: ～ような感じ means 'feels like...'

text: この場所は / データベースに該当する情報はありませんね
translation: This place... there's no corresponding information in the database.

text: これは死体 / トゥビー
translation: This is a corpse. / 2B...

text: あれ / 破壊されたエイリアンの墓船が
translation: That... destroyed alien motherships...

text: ようこそ
translation: Welcome.

text: 我が創造主の墓場へ
translation: To the graveyard of our creators.

text: お前たちは / トゥビー / 気をつけてください / 私の名前はアダム / 君たちアンドロイドが探しているエイリアンはもういない
translation: You are... / 2B! / Please be careful. / My name is Adam. The aliens you androids are looking for are no more.

vocabulary.meaning: to search for, to look for
no longer exist, are no more

text: 何百年も前にこいつらは私たち機械生命体が絶滅させた / 絶滅させた
translation: Hundreds of years ago, we machine lifeforms made them go extinct. Made them go extinct.

text: 今度絶滅するのは君たちアンドロイドかな / 機械生命体は自己進化を繰り返して強化されていく兵器
translation: I wonder if you androids will be the ones to go extinct next. Machine lifeforms are weapons that continuously strengthen through repeated self-evolution.

text: ネットワークの上に芽生えた地図 / 創造者もそれを描画する / 大して時間は必要としない / 自分たちの創造主を倒すなんて
translation: Consciousness that sprouted atop the network. Even surpassing our creator. It didn't take much time. To defeat one's own creator...
grammar: ～なんて adds dismissive or surprised emphasis

text: いいんだ / こんな奴ら植物のように
translation: It's fine. These guys were like plants.

text: 単純でくだらない構造の生き物だ / 価値の中で私たちの興味は
translation: Simple, worthless structured lifeforms. Of all things, what interests us is...

text: 月にいる人類 / 人類? / そうだ
translation: Humanity on the moon. / Humanity? / That's right.

text: 人間は魅力的だ / 理解不能 / 記録によって / 同じ種族で大量に殺し合う
translation: Humans are fascinating. Incomprehensible. According to records, they mass slaughter each other within the same species.

text: 愛し合う / その行動原理は目を見張る不可解さ
translation: They love each other. Their behavioral principles are breathtakingly mysterious.

text: 私たちはその神秘に迫りたい
translation: We want to approach that mystery.

text: だからその模倣作品であるアンドロイドの職員に
translation: So we thought we'd have you androids, who are imitations of them...
grammar: Sentence appears incomplete in the transcript

text: 調査を手伝ってもらいたいと思った / 手伝う? / そう
translation: ...help us with our investigation. / Help? / Yes.
grammar: ～てもらいたい means 'want someone to do (something) for me'

text: 月にいる人類を引きずり下ろして / 生きたまま分解して
translation: Drag down humanity on the moon, disassemble them while they're still alive...

vocabulary.meaning: to drag down, to pull down

text: 分析して / その秘密の全てを暴くんだ / こんな素敵なことは他にはないんだ
translation: Analyze them, and expose all of their secrets. There's nothing more wonderful than this.
grammar: ～んだ is explanatory/emphatic tone

text: そんなことやらせるわけないだろ / トゥービー
translation: There's no way we'd let you do that. / 2B!
grammar: ～わけない means 'there's no way...', 'it's impossible that...'

text: こんな奴らに惑わされちゃダメだ
translation: Don't be deceived by these guys.
grammar: ～ちゃダメ is casual prohibition

text: じゃあ交渉は決裂というわけだ / 滅ぼすしかない
translation: Then negotiations have broken down. We have no choice but to destroy you.

text: 君たちここにいる退屈
translation: The boring ones here with you...
grammar: Sentence appears incomplete or garbled in the transcript

text: 宇宙人とおやん
translation: Along with the aliens...
grammar: Sentence appears incomplete or garbled in the transcript

text: そろそろ時間だ / これが私たちの創造者の末路
translation: It's about time. This is the fate of our creators.

text: お前たちが信じる人間はどうかな
translation: I wonder how the humans you believe in will fare.

vocabulary.meaning: I wonder how, how will it be

text: 逃げられた
translation: He got away.
grammar: ～られた is passive form

text: エイリアンたちがすでに滅んでいた
translation: The aliens had already perished.
grammar: ～ていた is past progressive/state

text: とりあえずバンカーに戻って報告しよう
translation: Let's go back to the Bunker and report for now.

text: お父さんを殺しました
translation: I killed father.

text: お母さんを殺しました
translation: I killed mother.

text: お父さんを殺しました / お母さんを殺しました
translation: I killed father. / I killed mother.

text: その手には成長の喜びと
translation: In those hands were the joy of growth...

text: 一人になった孤独が
translation: And the loneliness of being alone...

text: 冷たく握られていました
translation: Gripped coldly.
grammar: ～られていました is passive past progressive

text: 以上がエイリアンシップの報告です / そうか、すでにエイリアンは
translation: That concludes the report on the alien ship. / I see, so the aliens already...

text: この情報は人類会議で結論が出るまでは最高機密として扱うことにする
translation: We'll treat this information as top secret until a conclusion is reached at the Council of Humanity.

vocabulary.meaning: to come out, to be reached

text: くれぐれも多言のないように / はい / 君たち二人にはパスカルという名の機械生命体の情報収集を命ずる / え?あの怪しい感じの機械生命体ですか?
translation: Make sure not to say too much. / Yes. / I order you two to gather information on the machine lifeform named Pascal. / Huh? That suspicious-feeling machine lifeform?

text: 月明の人類会議からの通達だ / 特殊な答えの調査は今後の作戦の重要な資料となるからな
translation: It's an order from the Council of Humanity on the moon. Investigation of special individuals will become important material for future operations.
grammar: ～からな is explanatory with masculine emphasis

text: 了解しました
translation: Understood.

text: 司令官も本当に人遣いが荒いですよね
translation: The Commander really works people hard, doesn't she?

vocabulary.meaning: treatment of people, use of personnel

text: しかも行き先はまた廃墟都市ですか
translation: And our destination is the ruined city again?

text: 久しぶりだし、ちょっと休んでいきません? / トゥビー / 気が向いたらね
translation: It's been a while, so why don't we take a little break? / 2B... / If I feel like it.

vocabulary.meaning: it's been a while, long time no see
to rest, to take a break

grammar: ～ていきません is invitation form; ～たらね is conditional with casual feminine ending
